subject: Runway cordon: soft-lock bridge and escalation plan
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helioshealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elliott Systems (procurement) <procurement@elliottsys.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + sequence questions

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the draft MAP and the call earlier — we worked through the internal acceptance calendar and there are a few emergent procurement constraints that put our target go-live at risk. High level:

- Procurement needs a signed PO + SOC2 evidence before our April 30 acceptance window.
- Our pilot cohort needs a one-week buffer for integration validation (we had assumed 48 hours).
- Legal wants a clarified data retention clause tied to private deployment options.

I attached the edited MAP (Helios_MAP_v3.xlsx) with inline highlight rows showing the blockers. Can we get a revised MAP that:
1) shows a soft-lock period where we can accept feature parity but delay cutover;
2) proposes a contingency acceptance lane if procurement misses April 30; and
3) confirms which Redwood model variant you'd commit to for the pilot (latency profile matters).

If we can't hit April 30, procurement has asked for an explicit escalation path and an approval cadence to push the window to May 14. Happy to jump on a short call today.

Best,
Samira Khan
Director, Digital Programs
Helios Health

Attachments: Helios_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Elliott Systems (procurement) <procurement@elliottsys.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + sequence questions

Samira — thanks for the quick read and the highlights, very helpful. I'm looping Marissa (CS lead) and Grace (solutions) to lock down the operational options. Quick answers up front:

- Model variant: we can pin the pilot to rwd-open-2-13b (quantized) to hit the latency SLAs you called out; we will include a fallback stub to rwd-2-7b if GPU pressure spikes.
- Soft-lock proposal: we can formalize a "soft-lock corridor" in the MAP where acceptance is feature-confirmation-only and cutover is deferred.
- Procurement / SOC2: our security team can produce the SOC2 artifact set within 4 business days once the PO is in flight — we will include the SOC2 excerpt in the shared Drive folder.

Proposed next steps:
1) We (Redwood) update the MAP to include two lanes: (A) target acceptance April 30 (hard lane) and (B) soft-lock corridor + contingency acceptance May 14.
2) Procurement to confirm PO timeline by EOD Wed (Apr 21).
3) If PO misses EOD Wed, Jordan/Marissa to raise an exec-level exception and propose a cost-neutral credit to bridge the acceptance window.

I'll upload updated MAP v3 with the corridor by EOD today. Can you confirm a 30-minute call at 3:00 PM PT to finalize the lanes?

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@helioshealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + sequence questions

Jordan / Samira — quick operational note after reviewing Helios_MAP_v3:

- Integration buffer: Helios' request for a 1-week validation buffer is reasonable given they have a bespoke EHR adapter. Let's capture explicit validation test cases and an owner for each test. I added a new tab in the MAP for test ownership.
- Escalation cadence: suggest a three-tier approval path: 
  1) Procurement owner (Helios) + CS (Marissa) daily check-in during soft-lock week;
  2) Jordan + Helios procurement weekly exec sync;
  3) Exception path: Jordan escalates to Sales VP (Grace) for sign-off on any date push > 2 weeks.
- Credits: We should keep credits as a last-resort. If procurement misses PO and asks to push to May 14, propose a single-week service credit tied to delayed SLAs rather than an open-ended discount.

I'll update the MAP and the acceptance criteria doc. Jordan — I can join the 3:00 PM PT call. Samira — does Helios have a canonical PO owner email? We'll need it for procurement continuity.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helioshealth.com>, Elliott Systems (procurement) <procurement@elliottsys.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Runway cordon: soft-lock confirmed, escalation record and next actions

Team / Samira — follow-up after today's exec sync. Short update and actions: 

1) Status: Helios procurement confirmed they will not complete PO by Apr 21; they requested the acceptance window be pushed to May 14. We agreed to a soft-lock corridor to allow integration validation while delaying full cutover.

2) Escalation record (for audit):
- Request raised by Samira (Helios) 2027-04-20 09:12 PT.
- Redwood proposed soft-lock corridor and two-lane MAP 2027-04-20 11:04 PT.
- Procurement confirmed delay and asked for May 14 window on 2027-04-28 15:30 PT.

3) Financial / credit posture: per Marissa's recommendation, we offered a one-week service credit tied to delayed SLA for May 14 instead of a percent discount. Procurement accepted the credit in principle; legal to finalize language in the SOW.

4) Next actions (owners / ETA):
- Jordan: upload MAP v4 with corridor + test ownership tab — 2027-04-29 EOD.
- Marissa: finalize acceptance test cases and attach Acceptance_Window_criteria.pdf — 2027-04-30 noon.
- Grace: prepare Exec Exception note if the push moves beyond May 14 — 2027-05-05 EOD.
- Helios (Samira): confirm canonical PO owner email and expected PO issue date — by 2027-04-30.

I've attached the updated procurement template we referenced (Procurement_PO_template.docx) and linked the Drive folder for SOC2 artifacts (shared in related_links). Please reply with any corrections — otherwise I'll capture this escalation record in the deal log and update HubSpot.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
